title: Make room for your eye.
audio: Original sample-free sine/harmonic synthesis with authored scene accents; archived source audio muted.
source_scope: Original source photography + genuine dated product recording and actual board export; procedural light is campaign art.
public_caption: It starts with something you notice: light, color, a moment you want to keep. I’m building LOOKSi, a photo and video editor, to make room for the way people see. The film brings together original Nepal photographs, actual board exports and a dated native tone-curve recording. The light interlude is original campaign artwork. Follow the build. Bring your eye.
alt_text: Make room for your eye. Photo + video. A tool I’m building around the work.
remaining: Creative review, media publication permissions and current placement check. Optional continuous current-build demo and founder narration are tracked separately.
